events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Rollins (MIL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Conley (MIN) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Bucks.
Turner (MIL) firms up over his left leg in Edwards' (MIN) path prior to the contact.
DiVincenzo (MIN) legally contests Turner's (MIL) jump shot attempt.
Kuzma (MIL) commits a take foul on Edwards (MIN).
Gobert (MIN) establishes himself in Kuzma's (MIL) path prior to the contact.
Gobert (MIN) makes contact with Turner's (MIL) right arm during his upward shooting motion, and the contact affects Turner's jump shot attempt.

Conley's (MIN) left arm is not in a legal vertical position when he makes contact with Porter Jr.'s (MIL) left arm.  The contact with Porter Jr.'s arm occurs prior to Conley making any contact with the ball,.
Conley (MIN) legally contests Porter Jr.'s (MIL) jump shot attempt.
